req_title: Account Lockout on Consecutive Failed Logins
rule_description: User accounts must be temporarily locked for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within 10 minutes to mitigate credential stuffing and brute-force attacks.
Promotional discount coupons cannot be stacked beyond 50% total order discount, and the calculated final cart subtotal must never fall below $0.00.
All payment authorization requests must supply a unique Idempotency-Key. Duplicate requests submitted within 60 seconds must return cached responses without charging the payment source twice.
Digital wallet balance deductions must execute inside serializable ACID transactions with pessimistic row locks (SELECT FOR UPDATE) to eliminate race conditions and prevent negative balances.

req_title: Cross-Border FX Precision and Banker's Rounding
rule_description: Currency conversions for international micro-settlements must preserve 6 decimal places during calculation and apply round-half-to-even (banker's rounding) before ledger persistence.
Automated sales tax must calculate state, county, and municipal tax rates based on the buyer's 9-digit postal ZIP code before final invoice generation.
An automated SMS confirmation must be dispatched within 3 seconds of payment authorization to the verified mobile phone number on file.
